Here’s the complete 12-week general strength program summary for your 42-year-old male client (desk worker, prior L4–L5 herniation, now asymptomatic). It integrates spine-safe strength, intensified Phase 2, twice-weekly cardio, anti-inflammatory nutrition, abs/core work, and sleep/recovery. Three total-body strength days per week (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri), two cardio days (Tue/Sat). No heavy spinal loading nor loaded spinal flexion; maintain neutral spine throughout.

Global guardrails and cues
- Avoid: back squats, heavy barbell deadlifts from floor, good mornings, sit-ups/crunches, deep lumbar flexion/rotation under load, heavy overhead barbell work that drives lumbar extension.
- Prefer: front/goblet squats to a box, split squats, step-ups, hip thrusts, trap-bar deadlift from elevated start, leg press, cable/dumbbell rows and presses, landmine press, loaded carries, anti-extension/anti-rotation core.
- RPE targets: Phase 1 = 6–7; Phase 2 intensified = 7.5–8.5; Phase 3 select lifts 7.5–9 (no grinders).
- Hinge depth: only to neutral; trap bar start just below kneecap at lowest.
- Progress: add 2.5–5 lb per DB or 5–10 lb on bar weekly if RPE allows and technique pristine.

Warm-up (each lift; ~12–15 min)
- T-spine extensions on foam roller; banded shoulder openers (1–2 min)
- Dynamic: cat-camel x8, hip airplanes x5/side, knee hugs x10/side, leg swings x10/side
- Activation: dead bug x6/side, side plank 20–30s/side, glute bridge x10 (2s squeeze), bird dog x6/side
- Ramped sets for first two main lifts

Core work (2–3 exercises after lifts; rotate)
- Dead bug, bird dog, side plank/front plank/RKC plank, Pallof press, SB/ab-wheel rollouts from knees, anti-extension walkouts, chops/lifts, bear plank, Copenhagen plank (short lever), plus suitcase/farmer carries. 2–3 sets each; 6–10 reps or 20–40s holds; RPE 6–8.

Cardio (twice weekly)
- Session 1: Zone 2, 30–40 min (bike/elliptical/incline walk/swim), RPE 4–5.
- Session 2: Low-impact intervals, total 24–35 min (e.g., 8 x 30s hard RPE 7–8 with 60–90s easy), with 8-min warm-up and 5–8-min cool-down.
- Keep 6–8 hours away from lifting if same day; maintain neutral spine posture.

Phase 1: Foundation and Technique (Weeks 1–4; RPE 6–7, tempo emphasis)
Week 1
Session A
- Box Goblet Squat 3x8 (3s eccentric)
- DB Floor Press 3x8
- Chest-Supported Cable/DB Row 3x10
- Elevated Trap-Bar RDL (from blocks) 3x8 (3–1–1–1 tempo)
- Half-Kneeling Pallof Press 3x10/side (2–3s hold)
- Farmer Carry 4x20–30m

Session B
- Split Squat 3x8/side
- Half-Kneeling Landmine Press 3x8/side
- Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown 3x10
- Barbell Hip Thrust 3x10 (2s top hold)
- Back Extension Isometric (neutral pelvis) 3x20–30s
- Dead Bug + Band Pulldown 3x8/side

Session C
- Leg Press 3x10 (neutral pelvis, stop before posterior tilt)
- Seated Cable Row 3x10
- Elevated Push-Up 3x8–12
- Reverse Lunge 3x8/side
- Side Plank 3x20s/side
- Suitcase Carry 4x20m/side

Week 2
- Keep exercises; first two lifts each session now 4 sets; slight load increase if RPE <7; maintain tempos.

Week 3
- Add 1–2 reps on main lowers or small load; swap one row variation to keep fresh (e.g., 1.5-rep rows).

Week 4
- Early week: +5–10% load on main lifts if technique pristine.
- Late week (Fri): deload volume −30–40%; add SB rollouts/ab wheel from knees 3x6–8 if tolerated.

Phase 2: Progressive Strength, Intensified (Weeks 5–8; RPE 7.5–8.5; pauses/clusters; 2–3 min rest main lifts)
Power primers (before first main lift, 3–4 crisp sets)
- A day: Med ball chest pass 3x3–4 + low box or step-up jump 3x3 (only if pain-free; soft, shallow landings).
- B/C day: Med ball scoop toss 3x3–4.

Week 5
Session A
- Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat 5x6–7/side (2s eccentric), RPE 8
- DB Bench Press (flat) 4x6–7, RPE 8
- Chest-Supported Row (pronated, 1s pause) 4x6–8, RPE 8
- Trap-Bar Deadlift (elevated; 1s pause just off floor) 5x4, RPE 8
- Pallof Press to Overhead 3x8/side
- Farmer Carry 5x35–40m heavy

Session B

- 1-Arm Landmine Press (split stance) 4x6–7/side, RPE 8
- Neutral/Wide Pulldown (pause) 4x6–8, RPE 8
- Barbell Hip Thrust 5x5, RPE 8–8.5 (2–3s squeeze)
- Dead Bug with Band Pulldown 3x8/side
- Suitcase Carry 5x25–30m/side heavy

Session C

- Incline DB Press 4x6–7, RPE 8
- Seated Cable Row (2s pause) 4x6–8, RPE 8
- DB RDL (mid-shin max; 2s pause at mid-shin) 4x6–8, RPE 7.5
- Side Plank March 3x25–35s/side

Week 6

Week 7

- Incline DB Press 5x5, RPE 8–8.5
- Half-Kneeling 1-Arm Cable Row 4x6–8/side (2s pause)
- DB RDL 4x6, RPE 8 (neutral maintained)
- Anti-Extension Walkouts 3x8
- Farmer or Suitcase Carry 4–5x30–40m heavy

Week 8
- Mon/Wed: keep Week 7; attempt +2.5% on primaries if ≤RPE 8.25 last week.
- Fri: taper volume −35–40%, first set around RPE 7.5; remove clusters and slightly reduce carry loads.

Phase 3: Consolidation and Intensity (Weeks 9–12; RPE 7.5–9 selective)
Week 9

- 2-KB Front-Rack Box Squat 4x6 (light-moderate; perfect posture)
- DB Bench (heavier) 4x6
- Chest-Supported Row 4x6–8
- Trap-Bar Deadlift (elevated) 5x4, RPE 7.5–8

- Landmine Press (standing, glutes on) 4x6/side
- Neutral-Grip Pulldown (pause) 4x6–8
- Barbell Hip Thrust 5x5 (2s squeeze)
- Copenhagen Plank (short lever) 3x15–20s/side

Session C

- Incline DB Press 3x8
- 1-Arm Cable Row (half-kneeling, pause) 3x8/side
- DB RDL 4x8 (moderate; neutral)
- Suitcase Carry (heaviest tolerable with posture) 5x25–30m/side

Week 10
- Progress main lifts 2.5–5% if last week ≤RPE 8; add low-rep power primer: MB chest pass 3x3 and scoop toss 3x3.
- Optional: swap DB RDL for Cable Pull-Through 4x10 (2s glute squeeze) if lumbar endurance fatigues.

Week 11 (peak within constraints)
- 2-KB Front-Rack Box Squat: work to top set 4 @ RPE 8–8.5; 2 back-off sets x4 at −10%.
- Trap-Bar Deadlift (elevated): 4x3 @ RPE 8, strict resets.
- Hip Thrust: 4x4–5 heavy with 2–3s hold.
- Presses/rows: 4x6 heavy.
- Carries: heavy, posture immaculate.
- Keep cardio easy-moderate; prioritize sleep and mobility.

Week 12: Testing Week (safe maxes; two test sessions, 48+ hours apart)
Testing lifts (choose 4–6 total)
- Lower: Trap-Bar Deadlift (elevated) 2–3RM, estimate 1RM; 2-KB Front-Rack Box Squat 1–3RM (test true 1RM only if pristine; else estimate).
- Upper: DB Bench 3–5RM; Landmine Press 3–5RM.
- Pull: Chest-Supported Row 6RM or Neutral Pulldown 5RM.
- Optional: Hip Thrust 1–3RM if setup rock-solid.

Session 1 (Mon): Press + Squat
- Power primer: MB chest pass 3x3
- DB Bench: ramp to best 3–5RM (RPE 9, no grinders); 2x3–4 back-off @ −10%
- 2-KB Front-Rack Box Squat: ramp to 1–3RM (stop if pelvis tucks/torso collapses); 2x2–3 back-off @ −10%
- Row 6RM; core: Pallof 2x8/side + Suitcase carry 3x20–25m (medium)

Session 2 (Thu): Hinge + Landmine Press (+ optional Hip Thrust)
- Power primer: MB scoop toss 3x3
- Trap-Bar Deadlift (elevated): ramp to smooth 2–3RM (RPE 9 cap); 2x2 back-off @ −10% with 1s pause off floor
- Landmine Press: ramp to 3–5RM; optional Hip Thrust 1–3RM if no back irritation
- Core: SB/ab-wheel rollouts 2x6–8 + Farmer carry 3x25–30m (medium)

Taper into testing
- Prior weekend: prioritize sleep, light mobility, no hard intervals; cardio ≤25 min Zone 2 only.
- Fuel and hydrate well; avoid alcohol.

Anti-inflammatory nutrition (daily framework)
- Protein 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day across 3–4 meals.
- Fiber 30–40 g/day; 8–12 servings colorful produce.
- Omega-3s: 2–4 fish servings/week or 1–2 g/day EPA+DHA.
- Emphasize EVOO, nuts/seeds (walnut/chia/flax/hemp), legumes, whole grains, berries/cherries, leafy greens, crucifers, turmeric/ginger/garlic.
- Limit added sugars, ultra-processed foods, deep-fried items, and alcohol (≤3–4 drinks/week; none before training).
- Pre-training: 0.3–0.5 g/kg carbs + 25–40 g protein 2–3 h prior; optional small carb-protein snack 30–60 min pre.
- Post-training: 25–40 g protein + 0.5–0.8 g/kg carbs within 1–2 h; include berries/tart cherry.

Sleep and recovery protocol (highlights)
- 7.5–9 hours/night; fixed wake time.
- Wind-down 30–60 min: dim lights, cool room, light mobility, breathing (box or 4-7-8), warm shower 60–90 min pre-bed.
- Caffeine cutoff ~2 p.m.; minimal alcohol; last meal 2–3 h pre-bed (protein + carbs).
- Morning light 5–10 min; 500 ml water on waking; brief mobility/breathing.
- Movement snacks every 45–60 min at the desk; alternate sitting/standing; lumbar support.
- Post-lift cool-down: 5 min easy cardio + hip/thoracic mobility + 90/90 breathing.
- If sleep <6 h or HRV poor: reduce day’s training load/volume 10–20% or make it a technique day.

Safety and modifications

Emphasis is on hip-dominant patterns with neutral spine, spinal stiffness/bracing, unilateral work, machines and cable-based loading, and progressive overload without compressive or flexion stress. We’ll test 1RM equivalents on exercises that don’t violate “no heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion.” For bilateral lower body we’ll use a hip-dominant option with elevated start and a non-compressive squat pattern. Testing lifts (choose 4–6 total across two sessions)
- Lower body (pick one or both)
  - Trap-bar deadlift from elevated start (just below kneecap). Cap at RPE 9, no grinders; use 2–3RM and calculate 1RM.
  - 2-KB front-rack box squat (box height that preserves neutral pelvis). Test true 1RM if form pristine; otherwise 2–3RM and convert.
- Upper body presses (pick two)
  - DB bench press. Test 3–5RM and convert.

- Posterior chain accessory (optional)
  - Barbell hip thrust. You may test a true 1RM if setup is rock-solid; otherwise 2–3RM and convert.

1RM conversion guides
- Estimated 1RM = load / (1 − reps × 0.03) for 2–10 reps.
- Rough multipliers: 2RM ≈ 95% 1RM; 3RM ≈ 92%; 4RM ≈ 89%; 5RM ≈ 86%.

Global guardrails and cues
- Avoid: back squats, heavy barbell deadlifts from floor, good mornings, sit-ups/crunches, deep lumbar flexion/rotation under load, heavy overhead barbell work that drives lumbar extension.
- Prefer: front/goblet squats to a box, split squats, step-ups, hip thrusts, trap-bar deadlift from elevated start, leg press, cable/dumbbell rows and presses, landmine press, loaded carries, anti-extension/anti-rotation core.
